Yes, thieves push thousands of dollars worth of product out the main doors. I've seen it happen. I've also seen shoplifters turn back or abandon their carts once prompted for a receipt. People greeters save the company millions, nationwide. And those millions go on to provide working hours to the staff (who really need the hours). Or, those millions go to provide lower prices for the customer.
Thieves think they are stealing from Wall Street fat cats. The thing is, those fat cats push the costs onto the customer or, more likely, the worker.
You may not like being asked for a receipt (I don't like being asked, either), but you benefit from it whether you know it or not.
